title: Integrating Novelty and Surprise for Experience Prioritization and Exploration in Image-Based Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.17373v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sample efficiency is a central challenge in reinforcement learning (RL), particularly in image-based domains where agents must learn from high-dimensional visual inputs. Traditional sampling often relies on random or suboptimal experience selection, leading to redundant updates and slow learning. Improving efficiency requires mechanisms that prioritize informative experiences while also encouraging effective exploration. Prioritized Experience Replay (PER) addresses part of this challenge by reusing high-value transitions, while intrinsic rewards promote the exploration of novel or uncertain states. translated_title: 结合新颖性与惊喜度进行基于图像的强化学习中的经验优先级排序与探索
translated_abstract: 样本效率是强化学习（RL）中的一个核心挑战，尤其是在基于图像的领域中，智能体必须从高维视觉输入中学习。传统的采样往往依赖于随机或次优的经验选择，导致冗余更新和缓慢的学习过程。提高效率需要优先处理信息量丰富的经验，同时鼓励有效的探索。优先经验回放（PER）通过重用高价值转换来解决部分挑战，而内在奖励则促进对新颖或不确定状态的探索。然而，这两者的整合尚未被广泛研究。本文引入了新颖性与惊喜度优先经验回放（NSPER），利用新颖性来捕捉代表性不足的状态，并利用惊喜度来暴露智能体对环境理解中的空白。我们进一步扩展了NSPER+R，将这些信号整合进回放机制中。
tldr: 本文提出NSPER及其扩展NSPER+R，通过结合新颖性与惊喜度信号来优化经验优先级排序和探索，从而显著提升图像强化学习的样本效率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces NSPER and its extension NSPER+R, which integrate novelty and surprise signals to optimize experience prioritization and exploration, thereby significantly improving sample efficiency in image-based reinforcement learning.
